notes: On 23 February 2023, about 30 residents of the Lavino neighborhood in Anzola dell'Emilia gathered in Bologna (Bologna, Emilia-Romagna), outside the oratory San Filippo Neri where a conference on land consumption sponsored by the city of Bologna was being held, to protest against the construction of a supermarket in a green area in Lavino. evidence: protest against the construction of a supermarket in a green area ... damage pristine soil, is likely to soar pollution levels

notes: On 30 January 2023, people demonstrated in Neubrandenburg against the war in Ukraine and its consequence on the government's energy policy. They also denounced inflation.

evidence: against the outsourcing of security services ... due to a reduction in wages

notes: On 23 June 2024, between 250 and 300 people demonstrated in Chambery (Auvergne-Rhone-Alpes). The event took place after the National Rally (RN) came first in the European elections in France and President Emmanuel Macron announced the dissolution of the National Assembly on 9 June 2024, prompting snap legislative elections, raising fears of a government led by the far-right party.
evidence: condemning far-right ideology, which the demonstrators deemed dangerous to women's rights

notes: On 7 October 2021, an unknown number of AG Insurance workers staged a protest at the company's headquarters in Antwerpen to denounce high work pressure due to telework.
evidence: to denounce high work pressure due to telework

notes: On 26 October 2022, Allianz Partner workers staged a demonstration, for the second consecutive day, in the Citylife neighborhood in Milano - Municipio 8 (Milano, Lombardia) to request that the presence in the company of the USB trade union, which workers have recently joined, be officially recognized.
evidence: to request that the presence in the company of the USB trade union ... be officially recognized

notes: On 28 October 2020, several hundred activists, mostly women, gathered for a rally in Mogilno, protesting against restrictions of abortions in Poland. The event was coordinated by the Women's Strike.

notes: On 12 October 2024, between around 3,000 and 5,000 Pro-Palestinian activists and campaigners marched from the Pyramid of Caius Cestius to Vittorio Square in Roma - City Center (Lazio) to demand a stop to the bombing of Gaza by Israeli armed forces. Protesters waved Palestinian, Lebanese and peace flags, and held a banner with the words 'With Hamas until victory' and 'Stop the genocide of the Palestinian population, stop the massacre in Lebanon', while chanting anti-Israel slogans. Members of ANPI, the Palestinian community, USB, UDU, CR and PCI took part in the event.
evidence: to demand a stop to the bombing of Gaza by Israeli armed forces

notes: On 11 February 2023, between 6,000 (according to the authorities) and 15,000 (according to the unions) people staged a protest march in Morlaix. evidence: to oppose the government's pension and retirement age reform

notes: On 1 April 2020, around 20 migrant workers and agricultural day laborers living in a tent camp in San Ferdinando (Reggio di Calabria, Calabria) staged a rally after the right-wing regional councilor for Security tried to establish a canteen service instead of meeting the migrants' request for help to get food that they could cook. evidence: migrant workers and agricultural day laborers ... after the regional councilor for Security tried to establish a canteen service instead of meeting the migrants' request for help to get food

notes: On 5 December 2020, between 600 and 1,000 persons demonstrated in Valence. The article criminalizes disseminating images with personal identifiers of a police or military officer, with the aim of affecting his or her physical or psychological integrity.
evidence: called for the removal of article 24 of the 'comprehensive security' bill ... especially on reporting on police brutality

notes: On 18 March 2023, around 400 people gathered in Gueret to oppose the government's pension and retirement age reform bill and its decision to pass it through the use of the Article 49.3 of the French Constitution. evidence: to oppose the government's pension and retirement age reform bill ... Also teachers and parents were present to denounce the school reforms

notes: On Mar. 5, 2018: Environmental activists held a rally in Tirana in protest against various construction works in protected and tourist areas.
